p_pct.definition: PLACEHOLDER isolation probability, percent, for the 18 replay hours + 6 look-ahead hours (same rule as addresses.json). replay = null means p_floor every hour.

isolation_tolerance_hours.definition: PLACEHOLDER assumption for a residential block (hours without access)

lost.definition: 1 = no route to any ED hospital in that replay hour

detour_min.definition: added drive time vs baseline; 0 = 1 min or less; null = no route

crit.definition: first closed crossing on the baseline path; null = none

red.definition: ED hospitals within 30 min that hour

assessed.definition: 0 = no baseline route in the graph (block on a road fragment): not assessed, never zero risk
